name: 10956 · New City, NY
findings: ZIP 10956 (New City) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10956 (New City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10956 (New City) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).
